translations.kjv: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
translations.ylt: `And the fruits of the desire of thy soul did go away from thee, and all things--the dainty and the bright--did go away from thee, and no more at all mayest thou find them.
translations.web: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

translations.kjv: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
translations.ylt: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, far off shall stand because of the fear of her torment, weeping, and sorrowing,
translations.web: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

translations.kjv: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
translations.ylt: and saying, Woe, woe, the great city, that was arrayed with fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and gilded in gold, and precious stone, and pearls--because in one hour so much riches were made waste!
translations.web: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

translations.kjv: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
translations.ylt: `And every shipmaster, and all the company upon the ships, and sailors, and as many as work the sea, far off stood,
translations.web: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

translations.kjv: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
translations.ylt: and were crying, seeing the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like to the great city?
translations.web: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

translations.kjv: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
translations.ylt: and they did cast dust upon their heads, and were crying out, weeping and sorrowing, saying, Woe, woe, the great city! in which were made rich all having ships in the sea, out of her costliness--for in one hour was she made waste.
translations.web: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.

translations.kjv: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
translations.ylt: `Be glad over her, O heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets, because God did judge your judgment of her!'
translations.web: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”

translations.kjv: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
translations.ylt: And one strong messenger did take up a stone as a great millstone, and did cast it to the sea, saying, `Thus with violence shall Babylon be cast, the great city, and may not be found any more at all;
translations.web: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

translations.kjv: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
translations.ylt: and voice of harpers, and musicians, and pipers, and trumpeters, may not be heard at all in thee any more; and any artisan of any art may not be found at all in thee any more; and noise of a millstone may not be heard at all in thee any more;
translations.web: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

translations.kjv: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
translations.ylt: and light of a lamp may not shine at all in thee any more; and voice of bridegroom and of bride may not be heard at all in thee any more; because thy merchants were the great ones of the earth, because in thy sorcery were all the nations led astray,
translations.web: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

translations.kjv: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
translations.ylt: and in her blood of prophets and of saints was found, and of all those who have been slain on the earth.'
translations.web: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

translations.kjv: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:
translations.ylt: And after these things I heard a great voice of a great multitude in the heaven, saying, `Alleluia! the salvation, and the glory, and the honour, and the power, is to the Lord our God;
translations.web: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

translations.kjv: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
translations.ylt: because true and righteous are His judgments, because He did judge the great whore who did corrupt the earth in her whoredom, and He did avenge the blood of His servants at her hand;'
translations.web: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

translations.kjv: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
translations.ylt: and a second time they said, `Alleluia;' and her smoke doth come up--to the ages of the ages!
translations.web: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

translations.kjv: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
translations.ylt: And fall down did the elders--the twenty and four--and the four living creatures, and they did bow before God who is sitting upon the throne, saying, `Amen, Alleluia.'
translations.web: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

translations.kjv: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.
translations.ylt: And a voice out of the throne did come forth, saying, `Praise our God, all ye His servants, and those fearing Him, both the small and the great;'
translations.web: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

translations.kjv: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
translations.ylt: and I heard as the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, `Alleluia! because reign did the Lord God--the Almighty!
translations.web: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

translations.kjv: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
translations.ylt: may we rejoice and exult, and give the glory to Him, because come did the marriage of the Lamb, and his wife did make herself ready;
translations.web: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

translations.kjv: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
translations.ylt: and there was given to her that she may be arrayed with fine linen, pure and shining, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.'
translations.web: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

translations.kjv: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
translations.ylt: And he saith to me, `Write: Happy are they who to the supper of the marriage of the Lamb have been called;' and he saith to me, `These are the true words of God;'
translations.web: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

translations.kjv: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
translations.ylt: and I fell before his feet, to bow before him, and he saith to me, `See--not! fellow servant of thee am I, and of thy brethren, those having the testimony of Jesus; bow before God, for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of the prophecy.'
translations.web: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

translations.kjv: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
translations.ylt: And I saw the heaven having been opened, and lo, a white horse, and he who is sitting upon it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness doth he judge and war,
translations.web: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

translations.kjv: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
translations.ylt: and his eyes are as a flame of fire, and upon his head are many diadems--having a name written that no one hath known, except himself,
translations.web: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

translations.kjv: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
translations.ylt: and he is arrayed with a garment covered with blood, and his name is called, The Word of God.
translations.web: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

translations.kjv: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
translations.ylt: And the armies in the heaven were following him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen--white and pure;
translations.web: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

translations.kjv: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
translations.ylt: and out of his mouth doth proceed a sharp sword, that with it he may smite the nations, and he shall rule them with a rod of iron, and he doth tread the press of the wine of the wrath and the anger of God the Almighty,
translations.web: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

translations.kjv: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
translations.ylt: and he hath upon the garment and upon his thigh the name written, `King of kings, and Lord of lords.'
translations.web: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

translations.kjv: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;
translations.ylt: And I saw one messenger standing in the sun, and he cried, a great voice, saying to all the birds that are flying in mid-heaven, `Come and be gathered together to the supper of the great God,
translations.web: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

translations.kjv: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
translations.ylt: that ye may eat flesh of kings, and flesh of chiefs of thousands, and flesh of strong men, and flesh of horses, and of those sitting on them, and the flesh of all--freemen and servants--both small and great.'
translations.web: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

translations.kjv: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
translations.ylt: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, having been gathered together to make war with him who is sitting upon the horse, and with his army;
translations.web: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

translations.kjv: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
translations.ylt: and the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who did the signs before him, in which he led astray those who did receive the mark of the beast, and those who did bow before his image; living they were cast--the two--to the lake of the fire, that is burning with brimstone;
translations.web: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

translations.kjv: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
translations.ylt: and the rest were killed with the sword of him who is sitting on the horse, which sword is proceeding out of his mouth, and all the birds were filled out of their flesh.
translations.web: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.

translations.kjv: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
translations.ylt: And I saw a messenger coming down out of the heaven, having the key of the abyss, and a great chain over his hand,
translations.web: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

translations.kjv: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
translations.ylt: and he laid hold on the dragon, the old serpent, who is Devil and Adversary, and did bind him a thousand years,
translations.web: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

translations.kjv: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
translations.ylt: and he cast him to the abyss, and did shut him up, and put a seal upon him, that he may not lead astray the nations any more, till the thousand years may be finished; and after these it behoveth him to be loosed a little time.
translations.web: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

translations.kjv: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
translations.ylt: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them, and the souls of those who have been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus, and because of the word of God, and who did not bow before the beast, nor his image, and did not receive the mark upon their forehead and upon their hand, and they did live and reign with Christ the thousand years;
translations.web: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

translations.kjv: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
translations.ylt: and the rest of the dead did not live again till the thousand years may be finished; this is the first rising again.
translations.web: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

translations.kjv: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
translations.ylt: Happy and holy is he who is having part in the first rising again; over these the second death hath not authority, but they shall be priests of God and of the Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
translations.web: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

translations.kjv: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
translations.ylt: And when the thousand years may be finished, the Adversary shall be loosed out of his prison,
translations.web: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

translations.kjv: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
translations.ylt: and he shall go forth to lead the nations astray, that are in the four corners of the earth--Gog and Magog--to gather them together to war, of whom the number is as the sand of the sea;
translations.web: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

translations.kjv: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
translations.ylt: and they did go up over the breadth of the land, and did surround the camp of the saints, and the beloved city, and there came down fire from God out of the heaven, and devoured them;
translations.web: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

translations.kjv: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
translations.ylt: and the Devil, who is leading them astray, was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where are the beast and the false prophet, and they shall be tormented day and night--to the ages of the ages.
translations.web: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

translations.kjv: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
translations.ylt: And I saw a great white throne, and Him who is sitting upon it, from whose face the earth and the heaven did flee away, and place was not found for them;
translations.web: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.

translations.kjv: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
translations.ylt: and I saw the dead, small and great, standing before God, and scrolls were opened, and another scroll was opened, which is that of the life, and the dead were judged out of the things written in the scrolls--according to their works;
translations.web: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

translations.kjv: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
translations.ylt: and the sea did give up those dead in it, and the death and the hades did give up the dead in them, and they were judged, each one according to their works;
translations.web: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

translations.kjv: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translations.ylt: and the death and the hades were cast to the lake of the fire--this is the second death;
translations.web: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

translations.kjv: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
translations.ylt: and if any one was not found written in the scroll of the life, he was cast to the lake of the fire.
translations.web: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

translations.kjv: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
translations.ylt: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth did pass away, and the sea is not any more;
translations.web: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

translations.kjv: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
translations.ylt: and I, John, saw the holy city--new Jerusalem--coming down from God out of the heaven, made ready as a bride adorned for her husband;
translations.web: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

translations.kjv: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
translations.ylt: and I heard a great voice out of the heaven, saying, `Lo, the tabernacle of God is with men, and He will tabernacle with them, and they shall be His peoples, and God Himself shall be with them--their God,
translations.web: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

translations.kjv: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
translations.ylt: and God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes, and the death shall not be any more, nor sorrow, nor crying, nor shall there be any more pain, because the first things did go away.'
translations.web: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

translations.kjv: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
translations.ylt: And He who is sitting upon the throne said, `Lo, new I make all things; and He saith to me, `Write, because these words are true and stedfast;'
translations.web: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

translations.kjv: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
translations.ylt: and He said to me, `It hath been done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End; I, to him who is thirsting, will give of the fountain of the water of the life freely;
translations.web: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

translations.kjv: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
translations.ylt: he who is overcoming shall inherit all things, and I will be to him--a God, and he shall be to me--the son,
translations.web: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

translations.kjv: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
translations.ylt: and to fearful, and unstedfast, and abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all the liars, their part is in the lake that is burning with fire and brimstone, which is a second death.'
translations.web: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”

translations.kjv: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb’s wife.
translations.ylt: And there came unto me one of the seven messengers, who have the seven vials that are full of the seven last plagues, and he spake with me, saying, `Come, I will shew thee the bride of the Lamb--the wife,'
translations.web: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”

translations.kjv: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
translations.ylt: and he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and did shew to me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, coming down out of the heaven from God,
translations.web: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

translations.kjv: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
translations.ylt: having the glory of God, and her light is like a stone most precious, as a jasper stone clear as crystal,
translations.web: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

translations.kjv: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
translations.ylt: having also a wall great and high, having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve messengers, and names written thereon, which are those of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel,
translations.web: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

translations.kjv: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
translations.ylt: at the east three gates, at the north three gates, at the south three gates, at the west three gates;
translations.web: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

translations.kjv: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
translations.ylt: and the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
translations.web: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

translations.kjv: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
translations.ylt: And he who is speaking with me had a golden reed, that he may measure the city, and its gates, and its wall;
translations.web: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

translations.kjv: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
translations.ylt: and the city lieth square, and the length of it is as great as the breadth; and he did measure the city with the reed--furlongs twelve thousand; the length, and the breadth, and the height, of it are equal;
translations.web: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.

translations.kjv: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
translations.ylt: and he measured its wall, an hundred forty-four cubits, the measure of a man, that is, of the messenger;
translations.web: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

translations.kjv: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
translations.ylt: and the building of its wall was jasper, and the city is pure gold--like to pure glass;
translations.web: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

translations.kjv: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
translations.ylt: and the foundations of the wall of the city with every precious stone have been adorned; the first foundation jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;
translations.web: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

translations.kjv: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
translations.ylt: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprasus; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.
translations.web: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

translations.kjv: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
translations.ylt: And the twelve gates are twelve pearls, each several one of the gates was of one pearl; and the broad-place of the city is pure gold--as transparent glass.
translations.web: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

translations.kjv: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
translations.ylt: And a sanctuary I did not see in it, for the Lord God, the Almighty, is its sanctuary, and the Lamb,
translations.web: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

translations.kjv: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
translations.ylt: and the city hath no need of the sun, nor of the moon, that they may shine in it; for the glory of God did lighten it, and the lamp of it is the Lamb;
translations.web: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.

translations.kjv: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
translations.ylt: and the nations of the saved in its light shall walk, and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it,
translations.web: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

translations.kjv: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
translations.ylt: and its gates shall not at all be shut by day, for night shall not be there;
translations.web: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

translations.kjv: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
translations.ylt: and they shall bring the glory and the honour of the nations into it;
translations.web: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

translations.kjv: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
translations.ylt: and there may not at all enter into it any thing defiling and doing abomination, and a lie, but--those written in the scroll of the life of the Lamb.
translations.web: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

translations.kjv: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
translations.ylt: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, bright as crystal, going forth out of the throne of God and of the Lamb:
translations.web: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

translations.kjv: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
translations.ylt: in the midst of its broad place, and of the river on this side and on that, is a tree of life, yielding twelve fruits, in each several month rendering its fruits, and the leaves of the tree are for the service of the nations;
translations.web: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

translations.kjv: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
translations.ylt: and any curse there shall not be any more, and the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it, and His servants shall serve Him,
translations.web: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

translations.kjv: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
translations.ylt: and they shall see His face, and His name is upon their foreheads,
translations.web: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

translations.kjv: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
translations.ylt: and night shall not be there, and they have no need of a lamp and light of a sun, because the Lord God doth give them light, and they shall reign--to the ages of the ages.
translations.web: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

translations.kjv: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
translations.ylt: And he said to me, `These words are stedfast and true, and the Lord God of the holy prophets did send His messenger to shew to His servants the things that it behoveth to come quickly:
translations.web: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

translations.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
translations.ylt: Lo, I come quickly; happy is he who is keeping the words of the prophecy of this scroll.'
translations.web: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”

translations.kjv: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
translations.ylt: And I, John, am he who is seeing these things and hearing, and when I heard and beheld, I fell down to bow before the feet of the messenger who is shewing me these things;
translations.web: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

translations.kjv: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
translations.ylt: and he saith to me, `See--not; for fellow-servant of thee am I, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of those keeping the words of this scroll; before God bow.'
translations.web: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

translations.kjv: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
translations.ylt: And he saith to me, `Thou mayest not seal the words of the prophecy of this scroll, because the time is nigh;
translations.web: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

translations.kjv: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
translations.ylt: he who is unrighteous--let him be unrighteous still, and he who is filthy--let him be filthy still, and he who is righteous--let him be declared righteous still, and he who is sanctified--let him be sanctified still:
translations.web: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

translations.kjv: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
translations.ylt: And lo, I come quickly, and my reward is with me, to render to each as his work shall be;
translations.web: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

translations.kjv: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
translations.ylt: I am the Alpha and the Omega--the Beginning and End--the First and the Last.
translations.web: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

translations.kjv: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
translations.ylt: `Happy are those doing His commands that the authority shall be theirs unto the tree of the life, and by the gates they may enter into the city;
translations.web: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.

translations.kjv: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
translations.ylt: and without are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the whoremongers, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and every one who is loving and is doing a lie.
translations.web: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

translations.kjv: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
translations.ylt: `I, Jesus did send my messenger to testify to you these things concerning the assemblies; I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright and morning star!
translations.web: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”

translations.kjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
translations.ylt: And the Spirit and the Bride say, Come; and he who is hearing--let him say, Come; and he who is thirsting--let him come; and he who is willing--let him take the water of life freely.
translations.web: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

translations.kjv: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
translations.ylt: `For I testify to every one hearing the words of the prophecy of this scroll, if any one may add unto these, God shall add to him the plagues that have been written in this scroll,
translations.web: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

translations.kjv: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
translations.ylt: and if any one may take away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the scroll of the life, and out of the holy city, and the things that have been written in this scroll;'
translations.web: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

translations.kjv: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
translations.ylt: he saith--who is testifying these things--`Yes, I come quickly!' Amen! Yes, be coming, Lord Jesus!
translations.web: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!

translations.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
translations.ylt: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with you all. Amen.
translations.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
